name: LLVM
description: LLVM is a collection of modular and reusable compiler and toolchain technologies. It provides the intermediate representation (LLVM IR) and backend infrastructure used by Clang, Rust, Swift, and many other compilers.

items.title: Official LLVM Tutorial: Kaleidoscope

items.description: Curated community resource cataloging tools and applications for LLVM development.

items.description: Covers checking out sources, requirements, and building LLVM from scratch.

items.title: LLVM Language Reference Manual
items.description: The ultimate specification for LLVM IR: instruction set, types, and semantics.
